summary: Form 8-K filed by STRATS Trust for Wal-Mart Stores, Inc. Securities, Series 2005-4, reporting a routine June 15, 2026 distribution to certificate holders. Trust is a synthetic fixed-income vehicle with Wal-Mart as the underlying issuer. No special situation event—serves only to notify of a scheduled payment, with no changes to terms, structure, or corporate actions. No board recommendation, advisor, or strategic review involved. Filing is a standard periodic trust update with no transaction or restructuring implications; risk-arb angle does not apply.
